object.attr: analysis: `git_history` stops at `max_entries` and `inspect_object` at `history_max`, so a history that looks complete can be cut short (CF-V33). `review_suspect_link` already reports this (MELLON-TRACE-SRS-118).
object.description: When Mellon lists an object's history and leaves out older commits, Mellon shall report that older commits exist.
